note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a UAE 5-8, 12bis; A06b UAE 5-8, 12bis; L05 UAE 17): ordinary naturalisation after 30 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, United Arab Emirates, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in the UAE for at least 30 years if non-Arab and three or seven years if Arab (lawful and continuous residence in UAE). ... Renunciation of original citizenship required. Exception made to naturalised citizens based on UAE 9 bis (see A24/A26). ... Person acquires citizenship of a foreign country.
